research_control: Both research variants use the same evidence eligibility, selection, numerical optimiser and one common critic; combined means one researcher call per company, not one total agent including critic.
output_budget_control: 1536 tokens per combined call versus two 768-token role calls; both use one 768-token critic call.
selection_control: Baselines retain the full configured universe; research variants use the same eligibility policy. Report candidate sets separately from allocation effects.
holdout_scope: New synthetic evaluation-only prices, withheld from decision functions. Not independently collected or statistically untouched market evidence; no tuning/search in this experiment.
